entity_raw.definition_raw:
Through intense focus, your magical strikes reinforce your ioun heart.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane Strike, Improved Unarmed Strike, wyrwood.

Benefit(s): While your unarmed strikes are imbued with power from the Arcane Strike feat, a successful hit with an unarmed strike grants you a number of temporary hit points equal to the bonus damage granted by Arcane Strike.
